name: E. S. Newman
role: Cattleman of the Niobrara Cattle Co.
bio: E. S. Newman was a cattleman who in June 1885 planned to move 8,000 to 10,000 head from his Niobrara range to Tongue river, Wyoming. That September he won the Montana stockgrowers' support for asking Congress to buy and kill diseased cattle at government expense, and in October he delivered 351 Niobrara Cattle Co. beeves at Medora.

moments.label: Offered resolution on federal purchase of diseased cattle
Delivered 351 Niobrara Cattle Co. beeves at Medora

mentions: E. S. Newman will clean up his Niobrara range and move his cattle, numbering from 8,000 to 10,000 head, to Tongue river, Wyoming.—[N. M. Stock Grower.
